title: Final Submission Checklist
description: CAT 100 textbook section on final submission checks, centered on a final submission checklist, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Translate each literal assignment requirement into a testable checklist row with a pass condition
Verify each row from the recipient's position, such as loading links in a signed-out window and opening the exported file you actually submitted
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
